Anything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] needs your real details before this goes out: date, start time, price and the booking link.

The accent colour is a tweak on the three main artboards - change it once and it recolours the ball, the band, the numerals and the rules.
A second direction, not a variation of the first: paper background, rotation ring, coral accent. Pick one and I will build the other two sizes to match.
